terminus.method: cross-author synthesis + mechanism refinement of prior capacity-migration model
terminus.sourceSays: The Nuannuan draft argues that residents may possess socially unrecognized abilities and that an exchange/intermediary mechanism can identify and realize their value; it also contrasts decentralized time-bank exchange with a work-team-centered model. The prior Lee Tung Street source showed that civic/planning capacity can survive displacement and move into other arenas.
terminus.mutherGenerated: Capability migration has at least two gates: portability and legibility. A capacity can move with a person or network yet remain inert if the receiving environment cannot recognize, translate or validate it. Recognition interfaces can enable transfer while simultaneously concentrating gatekeeping power.
terminus.addsNew: yes: adds a mechanism explaining why transferable capacity may or may not activate after migration
terminus.counterexampleNeeded: portable expertise that fails because a receiving system cannot classify/credential it; and successful decentralized recognition without a central gatekeeper
terminus.failure: causal evidence is not yet strong enough to treat legibility as a general law
